raw_block.rationale: Create a grounded baggage-cost calculator that fixes the observed process error: qualifying carry-on/personal items are excluded from checked-bag ordinals, every remaining bag receives its ordinal checked-bag fee, and a bag exceeding both weight and size limits receives the higher—not the sum—of those two excess fees. A joint current-source reader parameterizes the itinerary- and cabin-specific schedule so the helper does not hard-code either TRAIN answer.

reads.question: Read the current baggage policy and return the allowance, checked-bag schedule, excess bands, and excess-fee combination rule applicable to the current itinerary and cabin, preserving the source's literal fee values.

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Exclude no more than one qualifying personal item and one qualifying carry-on item from checked-bag ordinals.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For a checked bag exceeding both standard size and weight, add only the higher applicable excess fee to its checked-bag fee.

origin.quote: What is the exact integer ticket plus fees for every current bag?

source_obligations.statement: Return the exact integer ticket price plus the fees determined for every current bag.

source_provenance.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
